description: The Wuhan urban-park dataset describes major parks in the city in 2021. China University of Geosciences researchers and collaborators combine OpenStreetMap, points of interest and Google Earth imagery, then compare park areas with an official city report. The ESRI Shapefile includes identifiers, park names, addresses, coordinates and areas. ScienceDB releases the resource free under CC BY 4.0. The repository reports strong area agreement, but this is not evidence that every small or informal green space is covered. The snapshot can support simulations of access to public space, recreation demand and urban green-infrastructure provision. Its relationship to data-openstreetmap is explicit because OpenStreetMap is one of the input sources. Network travel times and park capacity would need separate inputs.
